basic_info.description: Welcome to your private retreat nestled in the vibrant Outer Sunset neighborhood. It's a wonderful condo- part of a well maintained, self-managed 2 unit building. The spaces are generous, layout sensible, and 3 full baths, all updated. The lovely kitchen, living, & dining areas open to a patio just asking for a grill thru a sliding glass door.  A few steps up, a terraced turf lawn w/paver patios for indoor-outdoor living.  Upstairs primary suite, w/walk-in closet, full bath w/soaking size tub, & private deck. Second bed & bath just down the hall. Full-size stacked washer/dryer & parking for one car in attached garage adds to the ease of living here on 47th Ave. While there are great homes in neighborhoods across the city, living just two blocks from Ocean Beach means sunset views, toes in the sand, & the ocean breeze whenever you want - perfect for reconnecting with nature. And less than a block away is the iconic Golden Gate Park, offering biking, gardens, museums, golf, & endless adventure. Great food is nearby, with Hook Fish and Black Bird Bookstore and Caf just down the block. You'll need to get busy exploring the small treasures that make the neighborhood so unique. This location truly embodies the California lifestyle ideal, blending coastal serenity with city excitement.
